_comment: Shape-satisfying constants for AccountWise's POST /v1/purchaseOrder. Everything environment-specific or per-run (vendor_id, vendor_name, order_id, purchase_order_date) is injected at runtime by cypress/support/helpers/accountWisePurchaseOrders.js — never hard-code a vendor UUID here, they are per-tenant. The address and phone are deliberately OBVIOUSLY SYNTHETIC (SKILL.md §8.6) — AccountWise stores them verbatim on a real document, so a plausible-looking street address or phone number would read as somebody's actual details in that tenant.
_requiredFields: Derived from the live Joi rejection of an empty body on QA: vendor_id, vendor_name, tax_type, tax, discount_type, discount, mailing_address_1, mailing_city, mailing_zip_code, from_address_1, from_phone, term, items.
_orderIdTrap: order_id is ALSO required but is NOT in that list — the server's Joi schema does not declare it, so a body without it passes validation and then dies in the service with a bare 500 and no detail. The helper always stamps a unique one. See the comment in createAccountWisePo().

items.description: Seed line item created by the StockWise AccountWise-PO integration suite

_metadataNote: metadata partitions for the close=false lane's stockWiseStatus filter. epAbsent (no metadata at all) is what a real buyer's purchase order looks like and is the condition SW-AWPO-API-TC01/TC09 exist to exercise; every other TC uses epExplicitOpen so that defect D1 cannot mask its own subject. See the seed-isolation note at the top of the specs.
